title: Moisture mapping and baseline records
audience: Coordinators, supervisors and trained workers who may be asked about, triage, refer or document cleaning and water-removal work after a flood or water event. Not a qualification or authority to enter a flood-affected building, energise its systems, or certify it as dry, safe or habitable.
learningOutcomes: Explain why moisture readings need a documented method and baseline, and why a single number cannot prove drying or safe occupancy.

instruction.heading: Scope and authority
instruction.body: This lesson teaches how moisture readings are recorded with their method, instrument and baseline, so that a reading can be compared and interpreted. It does not set a moisture threshold, prove drying or clear a building for occupancy. Completing it does not give a licence, certificate or approval.

instruction.heading: Moisture mapping and baseline records
instruction.body: Moisture readings depend on the instrument type, the material and the reference conditions, so a reading without its method cannot be compared with another. A single number cannot independently prove drying or safe occupancy. Record the material, the instrument, the locations and the baseline before work begins. Keep a measurement register that shows the instrument identifier, the method, the material, the location, the time and the limitations. Require calibrated and appropriate measurement, with expert interpretation of the results.

procedure: Record the material, the location, the instrument and the baseline before work begins.
Record the instrument identifier, the method, the reference conditions and the time for each reading.
Keep a measurement register that shows the limitations of each reading.
Use calibrated and appropriate instruments, and keep the calibration records.
Do not treat a single reading as proof of drying or safe occupancy.
Send the register to the competent professional for interpretation.

workedExamples.situation: A technician writes 'dry' on a wall after one reading, with no instrument, location or baseline recorded.
workedExamples.reasoning: No. Record the method and baseline, repeat the readings under a documented method, and send the register for interpretation. The single word 'dry' is not a result.

workedExamples.situation: A customer asks whether the register proves the house is dry.
workedExamples.reasoning: The register shows measured readings under a stated method. Whether the building is dry is for the competent professional to interpret, and the handover says so.

equipmentAndPpe: Moisture-measurement instrument with its calibration record, used under a documented method.
Gloves and clothing set by the hazard assessment.

commonErrors.error: Recording a number without the instrument or the method.
commonErrors.prevention: A reading without its method cannot be compared. Record both.

commonErrors.error: Taking a single reading as proof of drying.
commonErrors.prevention: Use a series of readings and a competent interpretation.
Record the baseline before work begins.

safetyAndRegulatory.point: This lesson gives no moisture threshold or pass value. Those come from the competent professional and the applicable standard. Completing it does not give a licence, certificate or approval.
A cleaning completion, a drying reading or a visual inspection is not a clearance for occupancy.

qualityStandard: The learner records the method, instrument, material, location and baseline for each reading.
The learner does not use a single reading as proof of drying.
documentationEvidence: Moisture measurement register: instrument, method, material, location, time and limitations.
Calibration record for each instrument used.
summary: Use a baseline and a trend.
Interpretation belongs to a competent person.

knowledgeChecks.question: A moisture reading shows a low number after drying. What can it establish?
options: Only that a single reading was taken. It needs its method, baseline and interpretation by a competent person.
That the building is dry and safe to occupy, since the reading shows the moisture is now low enough
That the finish can be reinstated now, since the reading is low enough for the job to proceed today

knowledgeChecks.question: Why does a measurement register record the instrument identifier and the method?
options: Because a reading without its method cannot be compared with another reading
Because instruments need an advertising label
To fill space in the file

moduleAuthority.heading: Module authority and restricted work
moduleAuthority.body: This module is training content. It does not grant authority to enter a flood-affected building, to carry out regulated flood restoration, to energise or isolate electrical, gas or solar systems, to remove sewage or contaminated water, to dispose of waste, or to certify that a property is dry, hygienic, structurally sound or safe to occupy. Completing this lesson does not give a licence, certificate or approval. Some of the work described is restricted to licensed, authorised or specially trained people, including electrical and gas work, structural assessment, sewage handling and some disposal. The site controller, the owner, the insurer and the competent professionals each hold separate decisions, and none of them replaces the others. Where the controlling authority or the competent professional is not identified, stop and refer.

stopWorkAndReferral.heading: Stop-work and referral rules for this module
stopWorkAndReferral.body: Stop and refer whenever any of these is true: permission to enter or written safety clearance is missing; the contamination is unknown; a structural hazard, a slip or a confined space has not been cleared; an electrical, gas or solar system is water-exposed or has not been licensed for re-energisation; an exposure has occurred or controls are not in place; the equipment or operators are not suitable; porous material is in question; hidden microbial contamination is suspected; a waste route is not yet known; or a party asks for a dry, hygienic or occupancy statement. A stop-work decision is correct. Record it, and restart only after the competent party has confirmed the scope in writing.
